what_happened: Research found that WitnessFamily/README.md's lower (Sharing-prefixed) table is not just mis-keyed but duplicates WitnessFamily/Sharing/README.md's own already-correct, already-wrapped table, and its 9 descriptions are stale in CONTENT (pre-Skeleton.lean-extraction architecture), not just counts; this was not named in the dispatch and changes the recommended remedy from a simple re-key to a resync-then-wrap.

Research report settled every per-row obsolete/re-home decision and supplied draft descriptions, so the plan phase needed only live re-verification (INV green, pinned-row line count, directory contents) rather than any fresh decision work; plan authoring was correspondingly fast.

The Verification Tier contract's cheaper-tier justification expects a suite name from suite_selection_select or a verify-deploy --only-gate subset, both of which are agent-system deploy gates that check nothing about FormalSystem/**/README.md content; suite_selection_select on those README paths returned 17 unrelated agent-system suites rather than the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel. Each non-final phase's justification names this repo's own covering check (scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --no-build) instead, which is the honest covering command.

Phase 6's task list expected the BXCanonical/README.md subdirectory rows' Lines cells to be replaced by real numbers under cols=lines after wrapping. The generator's inventory_rows() function shows Lines substitution for subdirectory rows is gated on cols=files-lines, not on rows=both/cols=lines; under cols=lines a subdirectory row always emits a literal em-dash. Verified by reading the writer's output (still em-dash) and by reading scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's inventory_rows() subdirs branch directly. No correction was needed to the implementation; the plan's one-line expectation was simply inaccurate and is noted here and in the plan's own task annotation.
